'''Boiled suuri''' was a seafood dish using the [[suuri]]<ref name="EGTD" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]],<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> as the main ingredient. When served, the shell of the suuri had to be cracked open to release trapped steam pockets.<ref name="EGTD" />
